breakdown.title: Signal Breakdown
breakdown.subtitle: Plain-English read of what each indicator is saying
breakdown.empty: No notable signals firing on this ticker.

bb_upper.label: Bollinger upper @ {pct}%
bb_upper.what: Price is sitting against the top of its 2σ envelope
bb_upper.why: Statistically stretched — most reversions happen from here

bb_lower.label: Bollinger lower @ {pct}%
bb_lower.what: Price is pinned to the bottom of its 2σ envelope
bb_lower.why: Often where bottoms form — watch for a reversal candle

rsi_overbought.label: RSI {rsi} (overbought)
rsi_overbought.what: Buyers have been in control for too long
rsi_overbought.why: Momentum exhaustion typically precedes a pullback

rsi_oversold.label: RSI {rsi} (oversold)
rsi_oversold.what: Sellers have pushed it well below the mean
rsi_oversold.why: Can mean-revert OR keep falling — don't catch a knife

rsi_sweet_spot.label: RSI {rsi} (sweet spot)
rsi_sweet_spot.why: Backtest shows the highest win rates between 50–65

macd_bullish.label: MACD bullish
macd_bullish.what: MACD line above signal, histogram rising
macd_bullish.why: Trend is confirming itself — common entry trigger

macd_bearish_divergence.label: MACD bearish divergence
macd_bearish_divergence.what: MACD histogram is fading while price is still rising
macd_bearish_divergence.why: Classic late-cycle warning — momentum is leaving the move

volume_surge.label: Volume surge ({z}σ)
volume_surge.what: Today's volume is well above the 30-day average
volume_surge.why: Conviction behind the move — institutional footprint

volume_dry.label: Volume drying up ({z}σ)
volume_dry.why: Lack of buyers makes any move fragile and easy to reverse

strong_trend.label: Strong trend (ADX {adx})
strong_trend.what: ADX above 25 indicates a directional, persistent trend
strong_trend.why: Trends tend to continue — momentum entries work better here

golden_cross.label: Golden cross
golden_cross.why: Long-term uptrend confirmation — a structural buy signal

death_cross.label: Death cross
death_cross.why: Long-term downtrend confirmation — a structural risk signal

pe_rich.label: P/E {pe} (rich)
pe_rich.what: Trading at a premium to its earnings
pe_rich.why: Little margin for an earnings miss — disappointment hurts more

pe_cheap.label: P/E {pe} (cheap)
pe_cheap.what: Trading at a discount to its earnings
pe_cheap.why: Margin of safety — downside is partially priced in

eps_growth_strong.label: Strong EPS growth
eps_growth_strong.what: Earnings are growing at a healthy clip year over year
eps_growth_strong.why: Quality compounder — earnings growth drives long-term returns

eps_growth_negative.label: EPS shrinking
eps_growth_negative.what: Earnings are declining year over year

revenue_growth_strong.label: Strong revenue growth
revenue_growth_strong.what: Top-line is expanding at a healthy clip
revenue_growth_strong.why: Demand is real — gives the earnings story a foundation

high_debt.label: High debt/equity ({de}%)
high_debt.what: Significant leverage on the balance sheet
high_debt.why: Higher fragility in a downturn — interest costs eat margins

dividend_attractive.label: Attractive dividend yield
dividend_attractive.what: Pays a meaningful dividend relative to its price
dividend_attractive.why: Income cushion while you wait for the thesis to play out

rr_strong.label: Risk/reward {rr}x (strong)
rr_strong.what: Upside to target is at least 3× the distance to stop loss
rr_strong.why: Asymmetric setup — small losses, big wins when right

rr_weak.label: Risk/reward {rr}x (weak)
rr_weak.what: Below the 2.0× floor the brain wants for new entries
rr_weak.why: Even if it works, the payoff doesn't justify the stop distance

regime_volatile.label: Volatile market regime
regime_volatile.what: VIX 20–30 or S&P caught between SMA50 and SMA200
regime_volatile.why: Brain is in caution mode — score thresholds raised, sizing reduced

regime_crisis.label: Crisis market regime
regime_crisis.what: VIX above 30 or S&P below SMA200
regime_crisis.why: Brain pauses high-risk picks entirely; defensive positioning only

iv_complacency.label: Options IV {pct} percentile
iv_complacency.why: Market is asleep on this name — textbook complacency tell

iv_panic.label: Options IV {pct} percentile
iv_panic.why: Market is panicking — premium-selling opportunity, but risk is real

near_52w_high.label: Near 52-week high
near_52w_high.why: Limited overhead room before resistance kicks in

near_52w_low.label: Near 52-week low
near_52w_low.why: Possibly oversold or in a downtrend — context matters

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: How Signa turns a few hundred tickers into a paper trade, what protects the wallet, and how it learns.
howItWorks.paperDesc: The brain trades a virtual wallet. No real orders are ever placed.
howItWorks.funnelDesc: Every scan runs the same steps. Most tickers stop early; each stop is recorded with its reason on the Today page.

steps.title: Universe
steps.desc: About 280 US, TSX and crypto tickers, plus names discovered during the scan.

steps.title: Trend-quality candidates
steps.desc: A free prefilter ranks tickers by trend quality, not by today's move. Indicators use completed daily bars only.

steps.title: Technical filter (pass/fail)
steps.desc: Price above the 200-day average and the 50-day above the 200-day; RSI ≤ 75; at most 15% above the 50-day average; 20-day dollar volume ≥ $10M (≥ $50M for crypto); no active blocker. Only candidates that pass get AI, up to 15 per scan.

steps.title: Grok live search
steps.desc: Grok reads X and the web from the last 48 hours. Results without citations get zero weight, and red flags only count when they are cited and material for the company's size.

steps.title: Sonnet screens
steps.desc: Sonnet 5.5 gives a verdict (BUY, HOLD, SELL or AVOID), a confidence and a win probability (p_win). A BUY counts as validated only with confidence ≥ 60.

steps.title: Opus decides
steps.desc: Every validated Sonnet BUY is re-checked by Opus 5.5. Opus's answer replaces Sonnet's; if Opus disagrees, nothing is bought.

steps.title: Risk checks
steps.desc: Reward/risk ≥ 2.0, computed from the final levels. 1% of equity at risk per trade, ≤ 10% per position; ≤ 8 open positions, ≤ 2 per sector, ≤ 25% in crypto. Skipped if correlation is ≥ 0.80 with one holding or ≥ 0.70 with two, within 3 trading days of earnings, or within 3 trading days of selling the same ticker. Candidates are taken by p_win, then confidence.

steps.title: Hard ATR stops
steps.desc: Stop at 2× ATR, always enforced: the thesis can never suppress it. Target at 2R, and a 2.5× ATR trailing stop once the trade is up 1R. Claude's thesis check can only close a trade early. Fills include slippage (10 bps stocks, 20 bps crypto) and CAD/USD FX.

howItWorks.breakerDesc: If equity falls 10% below its peak, new buys pause for 10 US trading days. Then the peak resets to current equity and buying resumes, so the breaker never locks the brain out for good. Stops keep working during the pause.
howItWorks.scoreDesc: A 2021–2026 backtest of 8,996 signals (technical layer only) found that a higher technical score did not predict better returns: the < 50 band did best and 60–64 worst. So the score no longer gates or ranks buys; it is shown for context only. Any edge has to come from the AI layer, and the Is it working? page measures whether it does.
howItWorks.learningDesc: Nothing changes a rule automatically. Every candidate, bought or skipped, is tracked 5, 10 and 20 trading days later against SPY. The daily report grades skip rules, p_win calibration and Opus vetoes. A pattern needs at least 30 observations and a confidence interval that excludes zero before it is even suggested, and you approve or reject every suggestion on the Brain page.

brain.wfUniverseDetail: Scans TSX (.TO), NYSE, NASDAQ, and 18 crypto tickers (-USD). Includes banks, energy, tech, REITs, ETFs, cannabis, and more.
brain.wfPrefilterDetail: Filters by volume (min 200K), price change (min 1%), and price (min $1). Reserves 5 slots for crypto. Configurable in Settings.
brain.wfRegimeDetail: Runs ONCE per scan. VIX < 20 = TRENDING (normal). VIX 20-30 = VOLATILE (cautious). VIX > 30 = CRISIS (defensive, High Risk paused).
brain.wfTechnicalsDetail: RSI(14), MACD(12,26,9), Bollinger Bands(20,2), SMA 50/200, volume z-score, momentum 5d/20d, ATR. Sweet spot: RSI 50-65.
brain.wfFundamentalsDetail: P/E ratio, EPS growth, dividend yield, payout ratio, debt/equity, profit margin, revenue growth, market cap, sector.
brain.wfMacroDetail: Fed funds rate, 10Y treasury, CPI inflation, unemployment, VIX. Hostile macro auto-blocks BUY signals.
brain.wfSentimentDetail: X/Twitter and web news sentiment via Grok (real-time, cited sources only), enriched with options flow data (put/call ratio, IV percentile, unusual volume). Score 0-100. When sentiment and options agree, confidence is boosted. When Grok is unavailable or its daily budget is used up, news is treated as a data gap. Skipped for Safe Income (10% weight).
brain.wfSynthesisDetail: All data sent to Claude with brain knowledge context. Returns: action, confidence, reasoning, target, stop loss, risk/reward. A BUY confirmed by Opus gets an independent Codex review.
brain.wfScoringDetail: Bucket-specific weights. Safe Income: dividends 35%, fundamentals 30%, macro 25%, sentiment 10%. High Risk: sentiment 35%, catalyst 30%, technical 25%, fundamentals 10%.
brain.wfBlockersDetail: 8 auto-AVOID blockers: RSI>75, hostile macro, low volume, fraud keywords, price<$1, VIX crisis. Override score regardless.
brain.wfActionDetail: Score 75-90 = BUY. Score > 90 = HOLD (overbought ceiling). Score 50-74 = HOLD. Score < 50 = AVOID.
brain.wfGemDetail: ALL 5 required: score >= 85, bullish sentiment >= 80% confidence, catalyst within 30 days, R/R >= 3.0, zero red flags. Instant Telegram alert.
brain.wfKellyDetail: Fractional Kelly (25%). Maps score to win rate. Max 15% position. VOLATILE halves sizing. CRISIS caps at 5%.
brain.wfSignalDetail: Persisted to Supabase with all metadata. Enriched with current price on read. Account recommendation (TFSA/RRSP) attached.
brain.wfAlertsDetail: GEM alerts instant. Watchlist SELL/AVOID alerts instant. Scan digests for PRE_MARKET and AFTER_CLOSE. Bilingual (EN/PT).

long.recoveredIn: {days} days to regain the old peak (on {date})
long.fundOfFunds: This fund holds other ETFs, shown as-is.
long.redFlagsNone: No material red flags found in a cited news and X search.

notes.ai_unavailable: The AI assessment was unavailable — the verdict comes from the rule-based scorecard.
notes.ai_disabled: AI analysis is disabled — the verdict comes from the rule-based scorecard.
notes.benchmark_currency_not_adjusted: Benchmark returns are in its own currency (exchange-rate data unavailable).

caveats.not_advice: Not financial advice. Whether it suits you depends on your goals, horizon and risk tolerance.
caveats.past_returns: Past returns (dividends reinvested) do not predict future returns.
caveats.heuristics: The scorecard uses simple rule-of-thumb thresholds; they ignore sector norms and context.
caveats.no_timing: This is a long-term view: it says nothing about whether this week is a good time to buy.
caveats.crypto_high_risk: Crypto is highly speculative: no cash flows, and drawdowns of 70–80% have happened repeatedly.
caveats.single_stock: Most individual stocks underperform a broad index fund over long periods.

kindHelp.compare: Compare 2–3 tickers side by side. Each one counts as a check unless a recent result is cached.

compare.help: Pick 2 or 3 symbols or company names.
compare.needTwo: Enter at least two different tickers.
compare.rankingRules: Ranked by verdict, then by the number of metrics each one leads
compare.aiEnglish: The summary is written by the AI in English.

notes.ai_unavailable: The AI summary is unavailable right now, so the ranking uses the rules above.
notes.ai_disabled: AI is turned off, so the ranking uses the rules above.
notes.not_enough_results: Fewer than two checks finished, so there is nothing to rank.

compare.tableCaption: Comparison of {symbols}. The best value in each row is marked “Best”.
compare.caveat: Not financial advice. This compares past data and model output; it places no trade.
compare.againLabel: Re-run every check (non-cached runs count toward today's limit)

errors.compare_duplicate: These are the same listing: {symbols}. Pick different tickers.
errors.compare_unknown: We couldn't find a recent price for {inputs}.
errors.compare_not_found: That comparison expired — run it again.
errors.daily_limit: This comparison needs {needed} new checks, but only {remaining} are left today. The limit resets at midnight ET.
errors.resolve_failed: Couldn't look up one of the tickers — please try again.

holdings.title: My holdings
holdings.subtitle: Your real long-term positions. Signa checks them every weekday after the close and helps you think about where new cash could go. Nothing here places a trade.
holdings.paperNote: Positions shows the brain's paper trades — this page is your real money.
holdings.disclaimer: Information only — not financial advice. You decide.

empty.title: Add your holdings
empty.body: Paste your tickers below, one per line. Shares and average cost are optional — every check works without them, and you can add them later.

examples.desc: CSV with a header row (tabs or ; work too)

empty.suffixHint: No need for .TO — Signa looks the ticker up on the TSX and US exchanges and asks you to confirm.

import.title: Import holdings
import.label: Tickers, one per line
import.checkingHint: Looking up each ticker on the TSX and US exchanges — about a minute for 30 tickers.
import.saved: Saved {n} holdings. Prices and checks are updating.
import.confirmHint: Check each match. When a ticker trades on both the TSX and a US exchange, Signa picks the TSX listing (or the US share when the TSX one is a CDR) — change it if that's wrong.

status.ambiguous: Check: trades in more than one place

notes.cdr: US share chosen — the TSX listing is a CDR

import.existing: Already in your holdings — shares and cost you leave empty are kept

chips.trendWeakHelp: Above its 200-day average, but the 50-day is below the 200-day
chips.trendBreakHelp: Below its 200-day average ({pct} vs the average)
chips.overweightHelp: {w} of your holdings — above your {max} limit

edit.title: Edit {symbol}
edit.invalid: Enter a positive number, or leave it empty.

totals.title: Total value (CAD)
totals.coverage: Based on {n} of {total} holdings with shares entered.
totals.fx: USD holdings converted at {rate} CAD per USD.
totals.fxMissing: USD holdings are left out — the exchange rate is unavailable.
totals.noShares: Add share counts (Edit) to see totals, weights and gains. Everything else works without them.
totals.weightNote: Weights are shares of the holdings with shares entered.

review.title: Long-term reviews
review.subtitle: The same long-term check as Check a stock — verdict, scorecard and the key concern for each holding. Reviews don't use your daily check limit.
review.allHint: Checks every holding, one at a time — a few minutes. Available once every {days} days.

allocate.title: Where could new cash go?
allocate.subtitle: Considerations ranked from your long-term reviews, the trend, the discount from the 52-week high and concentration. Not buy instructions and no amounts.
allocate.reviewFirst: Tip: run the long-term reviews first — the verdict is the biggest factor.
allocate.caveat: Not financial advice. These are considerations ranked from Signa's own data — not buy instructions or amounts. Your goals, taxes and account room matter more than any score. You decide.

factors.verdict_not_a_good_fit: long-term review: not a good fit
factors.modest_discount: a modest discount from its 52-week high ({drawdown_pct})
factors.steep_fall: a steep fall from its 52-week high ({drawdown_pct}) — worth understanding why
factors.red_flag: a cited red flag in recent news

notes.overlap_us_large_tech: {symbols} all hold the same US large-cap tech names (Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia…), so adding to any of them adds to the same exposure.
notes.overlap_mega_caps: {symbols} are also top holdings inside your broad funds — you own them twice.
notes.covered_call: {symbols} sell call options for income: a high yield, but capped upside in strong markets, and the price tends to lag the index over time.
notes.leveraged: {symbols} is leveraged and resets daily: it can lose value in choppy markets even when the index ends flat — usually a small satellite, not a core holding.
notes.group_bitcoin: {symbols} all track bitcoin — the same exposure twice.
notes.group_canadian_banks: {symbols} are all Canadian banks (XEQT holds them too).
notes.group_enbridge: {symbols}: E Split Corp's return depends on Enbridge — overlapping exposure.
notes.group_cash_like: {symbols} are cash-like (T-bills / money market): a place to park cash, not growth.

errors.invalid_input: Some values are invalid — check the numbers.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests — wait a moment.
errors.internal: Something went wrong — please try again.
